column9: THE tree of the 3×3 window: a tapering trunk, a crown that flares off it and closes to a point. Five rings is the fewest that still reads as a tree rather than as a lollipop — the flare at 0.42 is what makes a silhouette a crown, and the 0.46 waist above it keeps the top from looking like a cone on a stick. 6 segments × 4 ring gaps + cap = 162 vertices, 54 triangles

THE same tree seen from far enough that facets and waist are below a pixel: one flare, one point, four sides. 4 × 3 + cap = 84 vertices, 28 triangles — the LOD rung of the near row, and it is a ROW rather than a branch precisely so the switch is a choice of profile, never a second law of what a tree is
